description: Catalog of known anti-debug / anti-Frida / anti-emulator checks per platform, with bypass techniques and evidence tags. Never claim undetectable; all dynamic claims tagged [I] until hardware-verified.

checks.name: TracerPid check
checks.bypass: Rewrite /proc/self/status TracerPid line to 0 via Frida open/read intercept (bypass_antidebug.js)

checks.name: ro.debuggable check
checks.bypass: resetprop ro.debuggable=0; LSPosed HideDevMode spoofs Settings.Global

checks.name: ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME) self-detection
checks.technique: Calls ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME, 0, 0, 0) and expects EPERM if already traced

checks.name: /proc/self/maps Frida scan
checks.technique: Scans /proc/self/maps for frida, gum-js, gadget, linjector strings
checks.bypass: Filter /proc/self/maps lines to suppress Frida references (bypass_antidebug.js)

checks.name: ApplicationInfo.FLAG_DEBUGGABLE
checks.bypass: Frida hook on ApplicationInfo.flags to mask 0x2 bit

checks.name: Anti-root binary scan
checks.bypass: Frida hook on file existence checks to hide su paths

checks.name: Default Frida port detection
checks.bypass: Run frida-server on non-default port (38921 Android / 27043 iOS)

checks.name: Tuner/proxy detection
checks.technique: Checks for tun0 interface, http.proxyHost property, VPN service
checks.bypass: Use out-of-band eBPF capture; no proxy/VPN on device

checks.name: ptrace anti-attach
checks.technique: Calls ptrace(PT_DENY_ATTACH) to prevent debugger attachment
checks.bypass: Frida hook on ptrace to return 0

checks.name: sysctl kern.debugger
checks.technique: Checks sysctl kern.debugger for active debugger
checks.bypass: Frida hook on sysctl to mask debugger presence

checks.name: Amfi / entitlements check
checks.technique: Checks get-task-allow entitlement or AMFI restrictions
checks.bypass: Requires jailbreak with Amfi bypass; Frida hook on entitlement checks

checks.name: Frida gadget detection
checks.bypass: Rename gadget binary; use frida-server instead

checks.name: IsDebuggerPresent (Windows)
checks.bypass: Frida hook on IsDebuggerPresent to return 0; patch PEB.BeingDebugged

checks.name: ptrace check (Linux/macOS)
checks.bypass: Frida hook on ptrace to return 0

checks.name: Virtual machine detection
checks.technique: Checks for VM artifacts (VMware tools, VBoxGuest, /proc/scsi)
checks.bypass: Run on bare metal or clean VM; hide VM artifacts

checks.name: Timing-based detection
checks.technique: Measures instruction timing to detect single-stepping

bypass_techniques.procfs_rewrite: Intercept open/read on /proc/self/status and /proc/self/maps to rewrite sensitive lines in memory
bypass_techniques.ptrace_return_zero: Intercept ptrace(PTRACE_TRACEME) and related calls to return 0 instead of EPERM
bypass_techniques.resetprop: Use resetprop (Magisk/KernelSU/APatch) to mask system properties at the init level
bypass_techniques.hide_devmode: LSPosed HideDevMode module spoofs Settings.Global.adb_enabled at the system_server Binder level
bypass_techniques.non_default_port: Run frida-server on randomized port (e.g., 38921) instead of default 27042
bypass_techniques.eBPF_out_of_band: Capture TLS keys and traffic via kernel eBPF uprobes on Conscrypt libssl.so (no in-process tampering)
bypass_techniques.sigaction_handler: Install sigaction handler for SIGTRAP/SIGSEGV to neutralize anti-debug signal tricks
bypass_techniques.seccomp_bypass: Avoid seccomp filters that block ptrace; run in permissive seccomp mode
